title: CCTV still
description: A frame grab from a security camera. The image slot 'frame' holds the AI scene; camera ID, timestamp and labels are burned in by the template from these fields (never from the image).

camera.description: Camera ID as the VMS labels it.

timestamp.description: Burned-in date and time, recorder format.

site.description: Site / recorder name in the bottom-left corner. Falls back to brand.aliases.airport.

sceneBrief.description: Image prompt for the frame (used by the image stage, not printed). Describe a high, wide surveillance angle; no text in the scene.
examples: High-angle CCTV view of a crowded airport security checkpoint queue, travelers with rolling suitcases, fluorescent light, grainy, desaturated

caption.description: Optional analyst note bar at the bottom (as added by an export tool).
